note: Mostly forested tract on the North and South Forks of the North River, its south part a designated natural area where camping is not allowed. MDC lists designated camping but maps no camping spot; the brochure allows camping on or beside the area's one parking lot, a small lot off County Road 229 in the woods (this pin). --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE (parking-lot camping): area page lists 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey), Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots... No amenities are provided', 14 days in 30; but the 06/17 map has no camping symbol (one Parking Lot) and GIS has no camping point, so the only vehicle camping is at the single lot. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin = GIS lot 103 (under canopy). Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: CRITERIA / DROP CANDIDATE (lot allowance, no designated point): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey); Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. No amenities are provided. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed EXCEPT during firearms deer and turkey seasons... Camping and picnicking are not allowed in the Natural Area.' The map (© 06/17) legend is Boundary, Paved Road, Gravel Road, Drainage, Hiking Trail, Parking Lot, Pond, Forest, Topography - no camping symbol; one parking lot just west of gravel CR 229 north of the South Fork crossing. MDC's GIS camping layer has no point; the parking layer has lot 103 ('Paved', Allows_Trailers 'No') only. Unlike Edward Anderson (13863, same brochure wording but a GIS camping point), nothing marks a camping spot here, so this is lot-allowance camping - the brief's drop pattern.

PIN: stored 39.74887,-91.73981 = GIS lot 103. On the leaf-on frame the lot is entirely under canopy ~25 m east of CR 229 (gravel, visible) ~150 m north of the South Fork bridge; its size cannot be seen, so whether a 23-ft rig can turn in it is unverified.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the North River's South Fork is ~90-110 m SE of the lot through forest.
PHONE: area page and brochure '(573) 248-2530' match.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored; walk-in camping is closed in firearms deer and turkey seasons, vehicle camping at the lot is not.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the brochure's lot rule and the natural-area ban put in.
